answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 37762 Country: India Title: To whom can a will/wasiyatnama be done in Islam under Mohammedan law/Islam and to what extent Question: To whom can a will/wasiyatnama be done in Islam under Mohammedan law/Islam and to what extent? Kindly reply with Islamic references, in details. Answer ID: 37762 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 625/625/M=1433) One can make a will of some thing which he owns for a person who is not his heir; this will be out of one third property. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
